ios.desc:
UltraLocked is a local iPhone vault for private documents, photos, voice recordings, and notes. Vault files stay on your device unless you explicitly export them. No vault account or cloud vault is required.

DEVICE-BOUND FILE PROTECTION

Secure Enclave-backed P-256 keys support key agreement and signatures. File contents are encrypted with AES-GCM using CryptoKit in the app. App unlock supports biometrics and a PIN, with optional configured time and trusted-location checks.

PRIVATE DOCUMENTS AND NOTES

Start with a free Starter vault for up to 10 items. Import files, write encrypted notes, and capture photos, video, or voice recordings. Search file and note titles on your device. Pinch to zoom photos and swipe between photos and videos. Storage is limited by available device space. Supported speech features require on-device recognition; unsupported devices or locales cannot use those features.

ENCRYPTED TRANSFER

Export passphrase-protected .ultralocked bundles and import them on another device. Encrypted export and recovery import are available without a subscription. Verify a saved bundle without importing duplicate items. Backups cover selected vault files and notes, not Crypto Secrets or app settings. Item expiration still applies. Keep a recovery copy somewhere accessible without this device and keep its passphrase separately. We cannot recover device-bound vault keys or forgotten export passphrases.

CRYPTO SECRETS

Store recovery material with BIP-39 validation, configurable reveal delays, and Shamir sharing. UltraLocked is not a cryptocurrency wallet. Keep independently verified backups; an inaccessible or erased device vault may be unrecoverable.

OPTIONAL SECURITY CONTROLS

A duress PIN can show a decoy vault and request destruction of the real vault. Emergency destruction invalidates the vault master keys and removes associated files and secrets. This cannot erase copies already exported elsewhere or guarantee physical flash erasure.

File expiration and dead-man-switch controls enforce deadlines when the app can run. iOS does not guarantee deletion at a precise time while suspended, force-quit, powered off, or before first unlock. Local device and tamper checks are heuristics; they are not a guarantee against a compromised device or coercion.

SUBSCRIPTIONS

Premium lets you add more than Starter’s 10-item allowance. Existing files remain readable and exportable after your subscription ends. Premium is available monthly or annually. Prices,
